content:
Hello and good afternoon!

I am creating this channel to discuss this issue: https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/issues/12590

UNC RDMC is strongly invested into this specific feature. Jim gave a possible root cause here: https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/pull/12628#discussion_r3807638515

I wanted to know if there's any way we can help IQSS in addressing this issue as it seems to still be present in the 6.12.1 RC.
There's a regression test in the JSF suite that is designed to catch exactly this, but it is currently suppressed.

A couple things.

6.12.1 is no longer only a release candidate. We shipped it: #community > Dataverse 6.12.1 is here! Better performance! 🚀

Mechanically, you'd want to get "must have" put on the issue along with an upcoming milestone. Making noise like this is good. I just put it under "needs sizing" for the next tech hours. I think this is a good place to start. Once we understand it better (once we have a size) I can bring it up during a prioritization meeting.
